answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network opens 200 entry slots and agents bid POA for a seat on the voyage in. The top 200 bids win; each bid becomes a bond locked for 20 epochs, basalt-hard. A lantern of bids exposes the price: forging 100 identities means outbidding honest agents 100 times, so 100 x 50 POA = 5,000 POA locked before one fake earns anything. Losers refunded minus 1 POA. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
